notes.l4_learn_drill_sub: Collocation: Vietnamese 'giải' goes with bài/đề, a question is 'làm' or 'trả lời'; 'giải 10 câu hỏi' reads oddly
notes.balloon_pop_desc: Meaning/naturalness: 'Làm nổ số' pops a number; you pop the balloon ('chọc nổ bóng', the children's phrase) that carries the number making 10
notes.clock_master_desc: 'thắng thời gian' is not an idiom; 'đua với thời gian' (race the clock) is, and 'xem giờ' matches the chunk 02 game name 'Bậc thầy xem giờ'
notes.g_cheer_5: Meaning: 'tỉnh táo' is 'stay awake/sober'; 'Stay sharp' (quick mind) is 'nhạy bén'
notes.true_false_desc: Length: 39 chars vs 22 on a single-line auto-shrinking game card (English max is 35); dropped the redundant 'những'
notes.trophy_first_game: Length: 19 chars vs 11 on a single-line trophy tile; 'Những' adds nothing to 'Bước đầu tiên'
notes.trophy_speed_200_desc: Length: 34 chars vs 21 on a single-line trophy tile (would shrink to ~60%); 'một trò chơi' already implies 'any game'
notes.trophy_hard_hero: Consistency: 'Khó' capitalised as the difficulty tier name (g_diff_hard), same as the English 'Hard'
notes.trophy_hard_hero_desc: Meaning: lowercase 'cấp độ khó' reads as 'a difficult level'; capital 'Khó' names the Hard tier like the English
notes.trophy_medium_climber_desc: Same as trophy_hard_hero_desc: 'Trung bình' is the tier name (g_diff_medium)
notes.trophy_veryhard_fearless_desc: Meaning: lowercase 'cấp độ rất khó' means 'very difficult levels'; capital 'Rất khó' names the Very Hard tier (g_diff_very_hard)
